name: XAUUSD_SESSION_BREAK_SWEEP_V15
status_note: Fails 3 of 4 gates. TRAIN positive, but VAL negative (PF 0.33), walk-forward degradation 6.16, Monte Carlo ruin 72.2%. Best TRAIN config also won the day on 1 lucky month (2026-03 alone was +1406 of a +742 net).
hypothesis: Session-Break Liquidity Sweep. Range = first H1 candle after the daily session break. On M5 wait for price to sweep one side, then enter on a BODY close back inside the range with EMA9 confirmation. Stop beyond the sweep, target 1:1.5.

rules_as_given.step1_range: first H1 candle after the session break
rules_as_given.step2_sweep: low breaks -> look for BUYS; high breaks -> look for SELLS
rules_as_given.step3a_confirmation: candle BODY closes back inside the range (wick does not count)
rules_as_given.step3b_confirmation: price on the correct side of the 9 EMA
rules_as_given.step4_stop: buys below the sweep low; sells above the first post-sweep swing high
rules_as_given.after_stopout: wait for a FRESH setup that meets all rules again

deviations_from_user_rules: SELL STOP: the user's rule is 'above the first swing (red+green candle pattern) after the sweep'. This repo has no red+green swing primitive, so sells use the highest high of the M5 bars following the sweep. Closest available proxy; documented, not silently changed.

SESSION BREAK HOUR: TradingView's 'Session Breaks' is a user-chart setting and is not stored in the DB. Six candidate broker hours (00,06,07,08,12,13) were searched on TRAIN only; 12:00 was selected. If your chart uses a different break hour, re-run -- this result may not transfer.
ONE TRADE PER DAY: applied the user's 'fresh setup' rule conservatively as at most one position at a time.

sample.median_stop_vs_cost_ratio: 11.9x round-trip cost (8 pips) -- this is the ONLY reason the idea was testable

results.train_selected: break_hour=12 rr=2.0 breakeven=True hold=24 -> net=+741.6 PF=1.23 t=56 win=39.3%
results.validation: net=-423.8 PF=0.33 t=12 win=25.0%  <-- THE KILL

honest_caveat: XAUUSD M5 data covers only 2026-02-16 -> 2026-10-01 (193 broker days). Even a PASS here would be low confidence. The REJECT, however, is not merely small-sample: the edge does not merely shrink out of sample, it INVERTS (VAL PF 0.33, 3 of 8 months profitable, 72% Monte Carlo ruin). The conclusion is directionally solid even though the sample is short.
what_was_learned: 96% of session-break ranges DO get swept on M5 within 90 minutes -- the sweep premise itself is real and fires often.
The body-close-back-inside + EMA9 filter cuts 156 sweeps to ~50-90 qualifying setups per break hour, and those do NOT retain the edge.
Median stop is 95 pips = 11.9x round-trip cost. Cost is NOT the binding constraint here, unlike V1-V10. The premise was structurally sound and still failed, which is a genuinely informative negative.
Breakeven-and-hold did not rescue it: time_be exits were 18% of trades and overall expectancy stayed negative.
